features.name: Reified reference array allocation from compiled inline bodies
features.scope: marker0 plus ANEWARRAY with concrete reference, nullable, boxed primitive and direct nested array components
restrictions: Reified nested array marker encodings beyond a single substituted parameter and existing parameterized generic/function classifier boundaries remain unsupported; direct concrete array components are tested.
Generated nested allocations, context-sensitive invokespecial and array-owner method references retain explicit rejection boundaries.

features.name: Arbitrary reference string template values
features.scope: Object and nullable dispatch, null rendering, primitive/reference-array identity representation, evaluation order and thrown toString propagation
restrictions: Unit-returning expressions, nullable Unit and arrays with nullable Unit components in templates, and direct reified Unit array allocation remain explicitly unsupported; Unit singleton references are supported.
